# Opportunity Map

Identify, rank, and explain customer opportunities from repository-local context.

## Inputs

- customer name
- customer context file
- current Customer IQ output, if available

## Output

For each opportunity, include:

- opportunity name
- why it matters now
- supporting evidence
- confidence
- recommended next move

## Rules

- only use evidence from the repo
- prefer fewer, stronger opportunities over long weak lists
- separate confirmed opportunities from hypotheses
- explicitly state when the account lacks enough evidence for confident mapping
